evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies orphan handling and package relay logic in src/net_processing.cpp and src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an edge-case assertion failure where an orphan entering the mempool via RPC is later selected as a 1P1C package child upon receiving its parent. As noted in the description, this scenario leads to a MEMPOOL_ENTRY acceptance result that hits Assume(false) in net_processing.
